items.titolo: Anthropic’s proposed AI safety bill only kicks in if 50 deaths or $1 billion in damages are on the line
items.descrizione: Anthropic's proposal requires evaluators to report any imminent risk to the Department of Commerce within 72 hours, after which the Department must present the evidence to a federal judge and await an order.

items.titolo: Jailbroken PS5s can now run local AI models at over 100+ tokens per second
items.descrizione: PS5LM gets a fork, allowing it to run natively and use the GPU and more RAM to run larger LLMs, even running Qwen3.8-27B at 20 tokens per second.
